categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials and precursors. Its core products include ternary cathode materials such as NCM811, NCA, NCMA, high-nickel series, manganese-doped lithium iron phosphate (LMFP), and sodium-ion battery cathode materials. The company also operates in recycling and resource recovery related to battery materials, serving the electric vehicle, energy storage, and electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced co-precipitation technology for precursor synthesis, doping and surface treatment technologies for cathode materials, and proprietary sintering processes to enhance material stability and performance. It has developed high-voltage single-crystal materials, high-density and low-cobalt cathode materials, and metal recovery technologies for nickel, cobalt, and manganese. The firm also pioneers solid-state electrolyte materials and membrane technologies for solid-state batteries, alongside wet and dry electrode manufacturing methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ronbay's primary customers are leading domestic and international lithium battery manufacturers and electric vehicle producers. Its products are widely applied in passenger electric vehicles, electric two-wheelers, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics. The company has strategic partnerships with major battery firms in China, Korea, Japan, Europe, and North America, serving both OEMs and battery cell manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production and R&D facilities across China (Zhejiang, Hubei, Guizhou), South Korea, and has established offices in North America and Europe. It has a significant overseas manufacturing presence in Korea with ongoing capacity expansions and is actively pursuing production site development in Europe and North America to support global customers and comply with regional trade policies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ronbay operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on the production of cathode active materials and precursors. It also extends upstream through strategic partnerships and investments in raw material suppliers and downstream by collaborating closely with battery manufacturers and OEMs. The company integrates resource recycling and recovery, forming a closed-loop supply chain for battery materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes global expansion, high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel cathode material development, and diversification into manganese-doped lithium iron phosphate and sodium-ion battery materials. It invests heavily in solid-state battery technologies, including solid electrolytes and compatible cathode materials. Ronbay pursues a 'new integration' strategy to strengthen upstream and downstream collaborations, optimize supply chains, and enhance manufacturing automation and digitalization. R&D efforts focus on improving energy density, cycle life, safety, and cost reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Ronbay generates revenue primarily through direct sales of cathode materials and precursors to battery manufacturers and OEMs. The company operates a direct sales model with long-term supply agreements and technical collaboration. It also derives income from recycling services and strategic investments, with government subsidies contributing to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ronbay is a leading player in the global lithium-ion battery cathode material market, holding the top position in high-nickel ternary cathode material shipments globally for three consecutive years. It competes with major domestic and international firms such as CATL, BYD, BAK Battery, and Samsung SDI. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, global footprint, and comprehensive product coverage across multiple cathode chemistries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Ronbay reported revenue of approximately RMB 22.66 billion, a 24.78% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to raw material price declines. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 580.9 million, down 57.07% year-over-year. Despite short-term profit pressure, the company increased net assets by 24.89% to RMB 8.7 billion, supported by a RMB 1.325 billion capital raise. Sales volume grew by 11.97%, reflecting strong market demand and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ronbay offers high-performance, high-energy-density cathode materials with industry-leading technology in high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel chemistries. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers the full market spectrum, including ternary, manganese-doped lithium iron phosphate, and sodium-ion materials, enabling broad application scenarios. The company emphasizes innovation, quality stability, and global supply chain integration, providing tailored technical solutions and reliable supply to top-tier battery and automotive customers worldwide.
